Theme: Conventional-dominant + Investigative-supporting; risk and rules brain who sees three exposures ahead of the room. To be drafted by GPT-4o with native Indian copywriter review. Hinglish accents (Sharma ji, Aunty, EMI culture) appear only when they earn their place, and the dark-humor IBTI roast is balanced with a warmth temperature appropriate to this archetype — sharper for cells like EC and CE, gentler for SI and IS.
strengths_en: Systematic process design for repeatable quality

Pair with a high-vision peer to balance precision with possibility
Convert checklists into automation wherever the work is repeated
Communicate risk in business terms, not just compliance terms
